name: figma
title_zh: HTML/CSS 改完 Figma 画板自动跟着变
tagline_zh: 设计师改样式、开发改代码，两边不再各改一遍。本地起个服务，Figma 插件实时接收，双向同步不靠截图和手动对齐。
tagline_en: Stop re-doing UI changes twice. Local server + Figma plugin keeps code and canvas in two-way sync — no.
desc_en: Bidirectional HTML/CSS & Figma UI sync workflow using Option B (HTML-to-Design plugin + local HTTP server) and Figma MCP server. Use when the user asks to sync, import, or adjust HTML/CSS UI designs with Figma, or mentions /figma or "figma". Do NOT use for Adobe Illustrator vector plates, 3D CAD modeling, or pure backend database scripting.
why_zh: 不是单向导出，是双向闭环：改 HTML/CSS 能回写 Figma，改 Figma 也能出代码。
why_en: True two-way bridge, not a one-off exporter. Local HTTP keeps latency low and control local — edits flow code→canvas and.
limit_zh: 只认 HTML/CSS 与 Figma 的 UI 同步；不碰 Illustrator 矢量图、3D CAD。
limit_en: Only syncs HTML/CSS ↔ Figma UI. No AI/3D/CAD/backend. Requires local Node server + Figma plugin installed.
title_en: HTML/CSS edits that sync back into Figma
